title: Graduation Thesis Registration
text: Undergraduate students must have completed at least 100 credits to register for the graduation thesis.

title: Exam Absence Policy
text: Requests for exam absence must be submitted to the academic office within 3 working days after the exam date.

title: Maximum Study Duration
text: The maximum duration to complete the undergraduate program is 6 academic years.

title: Course Retake Regulations
text: Students receiving a grade below D must retake the course. Retake tuition multiplier is 1.5x.

title: Credit Overload Approval
text: Registering for more than 24 credits per semester requires approval from the faculty dean.
